method: Read all fourteen Chinese and English records in full; semantically compare biographies, every contribution, qualifiers, collaborators and caveats. Matching counts/URLs and absence of Chinese display text were also checked. Structural checks supplement rather than replace semantic review.

issues.before: Casimir was a Dutch theoretical physicist trained with Ehrenfest who worked in Leiden and later helped direct research at Philips. He investigated nuclear moments, superconductivity and electromagnetic fluctuations, connecting quantum theory with industrial research. He is particularly known for the predicted force associated with quantum vacuum fluctuations.
issues.after: Casimir was a Dutch theoretical physicist trained with Ehrenfest who worked in Leiden and later helped direct research at Philips. He investigated nuclear magnetic moments, superconductivity and electromagnetic fluctuations, connecting quantum theory with industrial research. He is particularly known for the predicted force associated with quantum vacuum fluctuations.
issues.reason: Preserve the magnetic qualifier in 核磁矩.
